_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id}, ukina {num_rounds} gukina Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Uwite amafaranga ${pool} kugabanya mu mukino wa nyuma kati yanjye na Umukino {other_id}.

Umukinnyi w'ikirenge:
  - Tanga ikirenge: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiyakubiriwa → Ufite $(pool - X), umukino mwingine ufite $X
  - Ikiyakubiriwa → Bombi bifite $0
  - Ifoto: [Offer: $3]  or  'Nkunda kuba nk'iyi. [Offer: $5]'

Umukinnyi w'ikirenge:
  - Shaka kuri ikirenge na [Accept] cyangwa [Reject]
  - Ifoto: 'Ikiyemerera. [Accept]'
            'Kibi cyane. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mukino {round_number} wa mbere! ---
Umukino {proposer_id} ni umukinnyi w'ikirenge, Umukino {responder_id} ni umukinnyi w'ikirenge.
round.accepted: Umukino {responder_id} yarakubitiwe! Mukino {round_number} unazamura: Umukino {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Umukino {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Ibyizura byose: Umukino 0: ${total_0}, Umukino 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Umukinnyi {responder_id} yatikiye igitambo! Mzunguko {round_number} witezweho: Abakinnyi bombi +$0. Ijambo ry'umwemerera ryasigara: Umukinnyi 0: ${total_0}, Umukinnyi 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Uwatanga igitekerezo agomba gutanga igisubizo akoresheje uburyo [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ikiguzi cy'igiciro kigomba kuba ari umubare wose.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Igiciro cyatanzwe kigomba kuba kiri hagati ya $0 na ${pool}.

outcome.win: Umukino {winner} yatsinze na ${winner_total} yose kuva na Umukino {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Abakinnyi bombi barangije bafite ${total} yose hamwe.
